name: Embers
tagline: An offline mesh of cheap sensor and edge-AI nodes that detects wildfire conditions where there is no signal.
problem: Wildfire detection relies on satellites or cellular sensors that fail in dead zones; the team cites a town lost in 20 minutes.
solution: Sentry nodes with environmental sensors and on-device vision detect pre-ignition conditions and smoke; low-cost relays pass alerts through a mesh to a base station dashboard without internet.
demo_moment: Team-described: trigger a node and see the alert hop across the mesh to the dashboard.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Works without internet, which is the gap it targets.
Anchored in a specific local disaster.

lessons: Design for the failure condition (no signal) and show it in the demo.
